comparison.objective: Assemble a retained hook tool and retrieve a cartridge, versus commission and lock an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-release tool assembly, hooking, extraction, and tool return versus fastener tooling, fine rotary adjustment, torque control, and feedback-driven tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Hooked travel, tray placement, intact return, and released stability versus repeated safe impact arrest and post-lock drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Tool assembly and hooked retrieval do not test damping calibration. No spec versions are present; the body does not state numeric travel or stability thresholds.
